prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System:Regional Flow Platform=Cedarbell;Meridian International Airport/Harbor East Airport/North Valley Airport/Lakeside Regional Airport retain authority. Aliases:Airline Operations Coordinator=Saffron;Regional Flow Manager=Copperfin;Demand Prediction Service=Marlinstone;Weather Ingest Gateway=Orchard;Airport CDM Portal=Foxglove;Tower Supervisor=Brindle;Ramp Control Lead=Quartzline;Slot Allocation Engine=Blueharbor;Slot Coordinator=Halcyon;Tower Sequence Manager=Ironleaf;Ramp Movement Board=Skylark;Alert Distribution Hub=Lantern;Departure Metering Service=Emberline;Arrival Regulation Console=Nightjar(help-only alias);Southport Airport retains authority. Airline Operations Centre→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange:Flight Intent Message;Identity Access Service authenticates;invalid/incomplete rejected(reason-codes);material intents supersede schedules;changes require messages. Cedarbell normalizes Airport Capacity Plan;Capacity Assessment Module updates Airport Acceptance Rate/runway/taxiway/sector/apron constraints. Blueharbor→Adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time/Target Off Block Time/arrival-opportunities;freeze:Pushback Window Token. Capacity>preferences;safety/emergency/humanitarian/national-obligation>commercial>discretionary;Ground Delay Program equity;changes justified;stands≠airspace override. Orchard validates weather/provenance/overrides;Storm Cell Snapshot confidence/degradation/provisional-capacity visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer verifies. East Apron Sensor/West Apron Sensor→Skylark→Surface Surveillance Adapter→Foxglove:movements/milestones≤5s;validated occupancy/equipment-status→Skylark/Ironleaf. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form;Brindle/Airport Duty Manager resolve conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter receive capacities. Modes:Normal Operations/Adverse Weather Mode/Capacity Reduction State/Recovery Phase(coordinated,commercial-logic-protected)/Contingency Fallback State(diversion/prioritization/communication/recovery). Saffron confirms plans/deferrals/revised-intents;Brindle distinguishes holds;Handling Resource Planner grades severity/suppresses recovery-duplicates;Ground Handling Dispatcher→Towbar;Aircraft Operator Representative supplies crew-legality;Halcyon reviews substitution exceptions/regional-objective. System Support

New part:
S704: The Common Situation Display shows the affected resource, start time, review time, and current decision status using language that can be understood by operational staff.
S705: The Alert Distribution Hub sends notifications when the constraint is created, materially changed, suspended, or cancelled.
S706: The Business Rules Registry defines which infrastructure events require approval, which events may be published as advisory information, and which events automatically trigger a Capacity Reduction State.
S707: During Adverse Weather Mode, lighting and navigation service limits are assessed together with ceiling, visibility, wind, and runway surface conditions before capacity values are released.
S708: During a Capacity Reduction State, the Regional Flow Platform maintains the infrastructure event as a controlling assumption until an authorized actor closes or supersedes it.
S709: The Collaborative Decision Log records the time of publication, approving role, capacity effect, affected services, and any later amendment made during the operating period.
S710: The Audit Event Ledger preserves the technical record of submission, validation, publication, acknowledgement, and withdrawal for accountability and post-event review.
S711: The Data Governance Steward monitors data quality for infrastructure events, including duplicate reports, inconsistent effective times, and unclear service descriptions.
S712: The Performance Analytics Warehouse uses completed infrastructure events to measure delay attribution, capacity recovery time, and the accuracy of initial duration estimates.
S713: When normal capability is restored, the Airport Duty Manager confirms closure in the Airport CDM Portal and the Regional Flow Platform returns the affected resource to Normal Operations or Recovery Phase handling as appropriate.
S714: Contingency operations cover any period in which the Regional Flow Platform cannot provide trusted automation for one or more airport, runway, apron, or airspace flow functions.
S715: A degraded operation is declared when data latency, service unavailability, or inconsistent operational outputs prevent users from relying on the normal decision support path without additional verification.
S716: The Airport Duty Manager is accountable for declaring the Contingency Fallback State after consultation with the Regional Flow Manager, Tower Supervisor, and System Support Engineer.
S717: The declaration identifies the affected functions, the operational area, the expected duration, and the authority that will approve restoration to Normal Operations or Recovery Phase.
S718: For voice coordination, the Contingency Operations Console is referred to as Silverpine during exercises and live fallback operation.
S719: The Contingency Operations Console provides a protected operating position with independent access to the Flight Data Exchange, Alert Distribution Hub, Audit Event Ledger, and Digital Briefing Room.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
